Organized by Hanno Eco-Tourism Association

Take a guided walk up Tenranzan and discover the subtle changes in nature you might miss on an ordinary hike.

【Fee】
¥2,000 per person; ¥1,500 for returning visitors; ¥4,000 per family (includes guide fee, insurance, etc.)

【Capacity】
10 people

【Guide】
Tsuyoshi Kojima (Wildlife Section)

【What to bring】
Drink, rain gear, backpack (something that keeps both hands free is best), towel, insect repellent
location: 集合 飯能市立博物館前（国際興業バス「OH!!!・天覧山下」または「市民会館・博物館」バス停下車徒歩3分）
